take_homes: The tool only knows what is in the conversation, so what I give it first shapes everything after.
The agent grades its own work too kindly. Treat its report as a claim, and get a second reader that did not write it.
Ask for a plan and approve it before the agent changes any files.

monday.move: Ask my controller to try the month-end variance commentary with an agent once, with plan-first approval on and a cold second check of the numbers.
monday.stop_condition: Any figure in the draft that the controller cannot trace to the ledger.
monday.blocker: IT has not approved the tool for finance data.

misconception.why: Nothing in the module covered licence cost or what the organisation has to build. The lessons were about prompting and checking, not about organisational capability. The plan-first and cold-read ideas were controls, but I still read the tool as a licence I buy.

one_line: The first ten minutes of context and the warning that the AI grades itself kindly were useful. Then there was a personal website and the same filler paragraph pasted in over and over, with no cost figure anywhere.
